headline: A one-off beat and a guidance cut, priced since the open: Hilton Grand Vacations is -1.2%
reasoning: Source: HGV's Q3 release (pre-open), summarized by Benzinga 09:23 ET: 'adjusted earnings of $4.03 per share, beating analysts' consensus estimate of $1.06'; but 'the results benefited significantly from the recognition of previously deferred revenue ... $536 million ... boosting net income and adjusted EBITDA by $296 million, or $3.76 per share'; and 'lowered its full-year profit forecast after contract sales declined'.
What changed: excluding the $3.76 one-off, EPS was about $0.27 against $1.06 expected, plus a cut to full-year guidance and falling contract sales.
Move: 35.09 vs Wednesday's 35.50 close, -1.15%, range 34.92-37.50. It opened up on the headline beat and gave it back as the market read the one-off.
objections: Priced through three hours of trading; the headline beat is one-off.
